reason: "the person in question, oneself" is a restatement of the existing EN gloss "the person himself" (and ZH 本人). 手続きは本人が行う is exactly the situation that gloss describes; nothing new is taught.

脇に抱える is the existing "armpit" (and "side") sense used adverbially; a learner reading "side, armpit" understands "carried under my arm" immediately. Worth noting the reverse of the usual pattern here: EN carries "armpit" while ZH has only 旁边/侧面 and no 腋下 — but that is a ZH-completeness question, not a new sense for this proposal.
"loss of employment" is the dictionary definition of "unemployment"/失业, not a second sense. 失業する in the sentence is the same noun used verbally.
"homemaker" is a synonym of the existing "housewife"/家庭主妇; the "full-time" component comes from 専業 in 専業主婦, not from 主婦 itself. Adding it would restate the only sense the word has.
"achieving a desired goal" is a definition of "success"/成功, phrased as a gloss. The experiment sentence is the ordinary use of that one sense.
会議中 is the suffix use already covered by EN "during" (and ZH 之中). "currently engaged in an activity" is the same in-the-middle-of sense described from the subject's point of view.

The head of the proposal — "feeling" — is contributed by 意識 in 罪の意識, not by 罪. 罪 itself is the sin/wrongdoing already glossed "sin"/罪过; this describes the sentence's phrase rather than a sense of the word.
"having a unique characteristic" is the adjectival use of the existing "uniqueness"/独特. 独特な香り needs nothing beyond the current line.

山田博士 is the existing doctorate sense used appositively as a title; standard dictionaries do not split "Dr. X" from "doctorate/PhD". A learner seeing "doctorate, PhD" (and ZH 博士, which is itself an address form in Chinese) reads 山田博士 as Dr. Yamada without help. The genuinely separate はかせ sense would be "expert / know-it-all" (物知り博士), which this proposal does not claim.
不満 already means the feeling: "dissatisfaction, displeasure"/不满. "feeling of discontent" is the same sense reworded.

EN lags ZH here — the documented pattern. ZH 遵守 already covers 約束を守る (遵守约定 is idiomatic), but the EN line offers only "to protect" and "to obey", and English does not "obey" a promise; the standard English gloss "to keep (a promise)" is missing, so an EN learner reading the current line beside 友達との約束は必ず守ります maps the verb wrongly. Note ZH already carries the sense; 信守 is added only to make the promise-keeping reading explicit alongside 遵守.
適用 is inherently the application of a rule, law or provision, which is what "application"/适用 already says; "a rule or law" is supplied by 新しい規則 in the sentence.
"to lead to a place" is the same arrival sense with an inanimate subject; dictionaries list "to lead to" inside the "to reach / to arrive at" sense. この道は…に至る is understandable from 到达 as well.
"magnification"/扩大 is precisely the zoom-in sense; "an image or display" comes from 画面 in the sentence, not from the word.
The EN list already contains "proxy" and "representation" (ZH 代理); 父の代理で出席 is that exact sense. Pure restatement.
"outrageous or absurd" is covered by the existing "ridiculous" (and ZH 岂有此理/出乎意料). とんでもない嘘 reads correctly off the current line.
